name: @fishjam-cloud/ios-client
description: Fishjam client SDK for native iOS

scripts.build: yarn prepare:project && xcodebuild build -project FishjamClient.xcodeproj -scheme FishjamClient -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -quiet
scripts.test: yarn prepare:project && xcodebuild test -project FishjamClient.xcodeproj -scheme FishjamClient -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}" -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -collect-test-diagnostics never -quiet
